jess: Heads-up: runtime team wants a short spec for how probe-driven suggestions can be accepted by the policy service without opening us to unsafe route swaps during rollouts.

noah: Short answer: keep compiled policy as the source of truth; runtime can emit suggestions but they must carry a tiny compatibility envelope + proof.

emily: Practically, the envelope needs: artifact_version (monotonic int), shape_hash (short hex), capability_flags (list), migration_hint(optional). Proof = xxhash64 over (shape_hash||node_path||delta||epoch) + confidence float.

jess: What about partial rollouts? We can't GC keys instantly since old artifact may still be in use on some canaries. Suggestion: runtimes accept proofs when artifact_version in {current, current-1}. Older -> ignore. Compiler emits migration_hint when node ids change.

noah: Migration hint should be a small map old_id->new_id (only when absolutely necessary). If map size > 100 require manual rollout. Also add migration_ttl in seconds.

emily: Guard rails: runtime advisory route is only honored if: 1) proof maps to an existing node (by node_path or id mapping), 2) confidence >= threshold (default 0.7), 3) capability_flags include "soft_eval". Otherwise runtime falls back to compiled default and emits metric route.advisory_rejected.

jess: Security-bot: proofs mustnt include secrets. Confirmed. Use deterministic hashes only.

noah: Tradeoffs: proofs cost ~8 bytes + CPU for hash. Acceptable. Collision risk low; if collision occurs fallback is safe.

emily: CI lints: 1) artifact_version must be monotonic. 2) reuse of node ids across non-consecutive artifact_versions flagged. 3) migration-table>100 -> blocker unless manual flag.

jess: Ops-bot: can we add a runtime scrub rule: remove namespaced probe keys where artifact_version < current-1 unless capability says cross-version-accept?

ops-bot: scrub rule noted. Canary window default: 1 hour; migration_ttl default: 3600s.

noah: Action items: emily draft RFC for envelope+proof+guardrails; jess add CI lint+rollout checklist; noah prototype runtime accept/reject counter metrics.

emily: I'll include two short examples: latency-first route with probe suggestion and cost-first route with lower confidence to show rejection flow. Filing RFC WIP to docs/rfcs and will ping arch-review.
